clips.title: The story
paras: At his cave northwest of Bloodhoof Village, Seer Wiserunner guides young tauren through sacred rites. The respected elder helps them seek spiritual wisdom in Mulgore.

Seer Wiserunner guides young tauren through their ancestral rites. After their first trials of strength and vision, they seek his counsel. He interprets visions of the Earth Mother and teaches them how to honor their forebears. His wisdom helps bind Mulgore’s scattered nomadic tribes into one community.
